column3: “Pains … sickness” is rendered “sorrows … grief,” and “hiding of face” as “one from whom men hide their face.”
“His generation, who will consider” is rendered “who considered,” and NASB supplies “the stroke was due.”
“He made sick” is rendered “putting Him to grief,” and “if it will make” as “If He would render.”
“He will see” is rendered “He will see it,” supplying “it”; “labor” as “anguish.”
“The many” is rendered “the great,” and “mighty” as “the strong”; “life” as “Himself.”
